overview: A 1947 inquiry and State's reply detail rules for mailing relief parcels to Japan: permitted goods, size and tobacco limits, customs treatment, and the need for Roman-character addresses alongside Chinese or Korean script.

subfiles.title: Airgram A-742 requesting information on parcels to Japan
subfiles.about: The airgram requests guidance on sending parcels, particularly foodstuffs, to Japan and on applicable size or quantity limitations.
subfiles.summary: Airgram asks what goods, including food, may be mailed to Japan, and what size or quantity limits apply.

subfiles.title: Department of State reply on postal shipments to Japan

subfiles.about: The Department explains the rules governing relief parcels and other mailed articles sent to Japan.
subfiles.summary: State details relief-parcel limits for Japan: permitted goods, quantity caps on tobacco, prohibited valuables, and Roman-character address rules.

interest: Shows 1947 rules on relief parcels to occupied Japan, covering goods, customs, and addressing requirements.
